1.e4 e5 2.Nf3 Nc6 3.Bc4 Nf6 4.d4 exd4 5..name: Italian Game: Scotch Gambit, Double Gambit Accepted

1.e4 e5 2.Nf3 Nc6 3.Bc4 Nf6 4.d4 exd4 5..strategy: Pins the undefended knight on e4 to the king, so Black must block the file at once or lose it. White is two pawns down for the moment, but has the lead in development and open lines in return, and the pawns are soon won back.

A gambit on a gambit: the knight attacks the one on e4 and offers a piece for an attack on the king if Black takes it. But Black can simply exchange knights and, with the better structure after the recapture on c3, gets the more comfortable game.
1.e4 e5 2.Nf3 Nc6 3.Bc4 Nf6 4.d4 exd4 5..name: Italian Game: Scotch Gambit, Nakhmanson Gambit

1.e4 e5 2.Nf3 Nc6 3.Bc4 Nf6 4.d4 exd4 5..strategy: Blocks the pin with a pawn that also attacks the c4-bishop. White regains the material, but Black gives back the extra pawn for a safe king and a comfortable, level position.
